desc:
🧈 Welcome to Squishy Butter & Squishy Dumpling! [2 Player Obby] 

🌸 A SOFT, SQUISHY ADVENTURE FOR YOU AND YOUR BESTIE! 🌸

🧈 Play as Squishy Butter or Squishy Dumpling, the cutest duo around!
🤝 Team up with a friend and beat every stage together!
🔗 Tied together by a rope, so if your partner falls, pull them back up!
🍓 Hold buttons, open paths and squish your way through satisfying stages!
🌈 Explore Sakura World and Sweets World, with more worlds coming soon!
🪙 Earn coins and unlock adorable Strawberry, Donut, Cheese and Gummy Bear skins!
🎁 Spin the Lucky Wheel and claim Daily Rewards!
🏁 Help each other reach the finish!

👍 Like the game if you love Squishy Butter & Squishy Dumpling!

🏆 How far can you and your bestie make it?
